case: a rebuilt table keeps its column and table CHECKs as written

tables.habits: CREATE TABLE habits(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60), state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'on' CHECK (state IN ('on', 'off')), note TEXT, CONSTRAINT short_note CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) < 20))

expected:
CREATE TABLE `__new_habits` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text DEFAULT 'off' NOT NULL,
	`note` text,
	CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60),
	CHECK (state IN ('on', 'off')),
	CONSTRAINT short_note CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) < 20)
);
